licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets capture the dominant clusters across all states: license/application fraud and deceptive statements; criminal convictions; malpractice, negligence, and incompetence; physical/mental/substance impairment; controlled-substance prescribing and drug-law violations; sexual exploitation of patients; broader unprofessional conduct (advertising, confidentiality, patient abandonment, scope violations, aiding unlicensed practice); improper billing, fee-splitting, and financial exploitation; and failures to comply with board orders, reporting mandates, recordkeeping, and supervision requirements.

profession_specific.license_status_types.rationale: These eight buckets cover the full distribution: standard unrestricted licenses, non-practicing statuses, short-term/provisional credentials, training-program permits, licenses with scope limitations or disciplinary conditions, revocation/suspension/surrender actions, niche purpose licenses (volunteer, faculty, telemedicine, administrative medicine, locum tenens, etc.), and the cross-state compact/endorsement pathway.
